classic_landing.label: Classic Landing
classic_landing.description: A conventional stacked marketing layout with a hero, clear sections, cards, testimonials, and a final CTA.

split_panel.label: Split Panel
split_panel.description: Pages rely on strong two-column compositions, alternating text and visual panels across the site.

editorial_grid.label: Editorial Grid
editorial_grid.description: A magazine-inspired layout with asymmetric grids, large type, image captions, and varied content blocks.

card_grid.label: Card Grid
card_grid.description: A modular layout built around reusable cards, tiles, listings, and feature grids.

gallery_first.label: Gallery First
gallery_first.description: An image-led layout where large visuals, galleries, lookbooks, or portfolios dominate the page structure.

dashboard_product.label: Dashboard Product
dashboard_product.description: A product-led layout with UI mockups, metrics, panels, charts, and feature modules.

storytelling_scroll.label: Storytelling Scroll
storytelling_scroll.description: A narrative, section-by-section layout that guides the visitor through a cause, journey, process, or brand story.

sidebar_navigation.label: Sidebar Navigation
sidebar_navigation.description: A layout with persistent side navigation and content-heavy pages, useful for institutional or documentation-like sites.
